title: M261c Open Images vision arm, larger trunk: frozen DINOv2-base + closed-form ridge head over the 601 boxable classes
question: Does the DINOv2-base trunk (86M params vs small's 22M) move the measured 0.1355 overall / 0.3665 per-class reading of the M261b arm on the SAME held-out test rows?
